name: retail-harness
description: Higher-order harness for the tau2-bench retail domain. Decomposes retail/policy.md by altitude: procedures become progressively-disclosed skills, price arithmetic becomes a deterministic script, the 'confirm before write' and eligibility invariants become a PreToolUse hook the agent cannot route around, and a policy-auditor sub-agent re-checks proposed writes. The domain tools are supplied by the fork's existing retail MCP server.
